new_wp03_finding.finding: V18 admits type/class declarations, while the current production TypedIR builder materializes only record/interface/fn declarations. Consequently a local type/class declaration can be omitted from typed semantic identity and a referenced local nominal can be classified EXTERNAL_NOMINAL.
new_wp03_finding.strongest_falsifier: A target execution showing the baseline TypedIR hash changes for a mutation confined to the RHS of a V18 type/class declaration would refute the reported semantic-identity blindness.

boundary_separation.wp03: Preserve already-admitted type/class declaration semantics and local nominal identity in typed IR.
boundary_separation.wp04_wp09: Atomic compare-and-set, authenticated capability binding, effect authorization and execution fencing remain separate runtime/type-effect obligations.
boundary_separation.reason: The counterexample is loss of semantics already accepted by the existing V18 grammar, not absence of a required surface construct.

distributed_delta.claycode: Do not promote WP03 until type/class declarations affect typed semantic identity and are classified as local declarations; keep atomic CAS outside descriptive TypedIR authority.
distributed_delta.frank: Single-spawn lease types must remain exact local semantics and must not be weakened into external/opaque guessed types merely to compile.
distributed_delta.unifieddb: Lease epoch/state identity remains authoritative mutable state; SQLite is a host reference/storage candidate, not ClayCode semantic authority.
distributed_delta.harness: Preserve simultaneous two-client, stale-epoch, zombie-holder, restart/recovery and same-holder execution falsifiers.
distributed_delta.gwt: No workspace/Needle output can supply or infer lease/effect authority fields.
distributed_delta.claygraph: Project lease/type/runtime dependencies diagnostically without making graph activation or topology authoritative.

external_primary_input.finding: SQLite serializes writers and BEGIN IMMEDIATE begins a write transaction immediately; this is an implementation control for short lease acquisition, not proof of ClayCode support.

duplicate_work_check.reason: The go lane tests runtime presence/execution exclusion and the concurrent WP04 lane tests effect CallContract binding. This lane tests the earlier compiler invariant: whether existing V18 local type/class semantics survive into typed semantic identity.
